title: ROWBLAA LUXURY
note: The top-level SITE model: brand, user-facing label vocabulary, feature flags, and the process phases (a SALE lifecycle here). The TAXONOMY is NOT authored here — it is DERIVED from the models' own data.types + each model's `configures` tag (see catalogue-build.mjs), so adding a model in the studio grows it. Optional keys: `taxonomy` (a seed of grouping-only classes that have no model yet, { id: { specializes, title } }) and `rootCatalogue` (the class the landing browses from; defaults to class_of_physical_object). Journeys stay here (activity rows, a different lattice branch).
